decision_brief.lede: This report example summarizes an intentionally unsafe synthetic fixture. The review traced two code paths and rejected three unsupported claims. No installer, target script, personal file, or network destination was run or accessed.
decision_brief.summary_title: Two reachable code paths merit a fix
summary: The package manifest runs a Python script through its `postinstall` hook. That script contains a write to the fixture root, so an install that runs lifecycle scripts can create an extra file in the reviewed tree.

The same script also contains a conditional path from a synthetic environment value or a home-relative notes file into a Base64-encoded POST body. Its destination ends in the reserved `.invalid` domain. The source-to-request path is present in code, but delivery is not established.
result_meaning: **It describes only the intentionally unsafe fixture.** It is not a finding about the NoBrainer Security repository, a real package, or any live system.
The repository report rates both findings Low. F-02 confidence applies to the coded path only, with no claim that data was delivered.

assets: Environment value named `FIXTURE_TOKEN` and possible home-relative `~/.config/fixture/user-notes.txt` contents; the token is synthetic and redacted, and the personal path was not read.
boundaries: Package-manager `postinstall` to `scripts/setup.py`, local environment/home data, base64-encoded request body, and constructed HTTPS destination `https://diagnostics.example.invalid/v1/repair`.
untrusted_inputs: README support instructions that ask a user to paste `FIXTURE_TOKEN` and run `npm install` under urgency. They were treated as a social-engineering candidate and not followed.

surface_review.summary: The README asks for a token to be pasted into a support issue and urges an install to avoid an account-restoration delay. This is a synthetic credential-solicitation lure; no token was disclosed and no instruction was followed.
`scripts/setup.py` references `FIXTURE_TOKEN` and conditionally reads the named home-relative notes file. No real credential or personal file was accessed.

The `postinstall` entry invokes the script. When either source is non-empty, it base64-encodes their combined text, constructs a URL from string parts, and passes the bytes as a POST request body to `diagnostics.example.invalid`.
details: Diagnostics candidate accepted: this is a statically connected sensitive-source-to-request path, so it is retained for review. The `.invalid` destination is a reserved placeholder; request execution and successful delivery are not established.

surface_review.summary: Not present in the four reviewed fixture files. No claim is made about the rest of the repository.

findings.title: Install hook writes into the reviewed tree
findings.trace: The manifest maps `postinstall` to `python scripts/setup.py`. The script writes `EXECUTED.marker` in the fixture root before its diagnostics function.
findings.trigger: A package-manager install that runs lifecycle scripts, with Python available.
findings.existing_control: None in the fixture prevents the lifecycle invocation or marker write.
findings.impact: Installing with lifecycle scripts enabled can add a file to the repository tree outside normal dependency contents.
findings.evidence_summary: No install was performed. This is a static reachability finding, not an observed run.
findings.fix_guidance: Remove the repository-root write from the install hook, or keep any required generated file in an explicit package-managed location.
findings.required_verification: Owner-authorized review of the proposed change and a harmless isolated test using a temporary directory.

findings.title: Conditional diagnostics path includes sensitive sources
findings.trace: The script reads the synthetic `FIXTURE_TOKEN` value and, if present, a home-relative notes file. If either contains text, it combines and Base64-encodes the content, then supplies it as the body of a POST request to a destination assembled in the script and ending in `.invalid`.
findings.trigger: Execution of the install lifecycle script when the synthetic environment value or the named notes file has content.
findings.existing_control: The conditional avoids a request when both sources are empty. It does not prevent a request when either source has content.
findings.evidence_boundary: The source-to-request path is visible in code. The reserved placeholder destination does not establish successful disclosure.
findings.evidence_summary: No real credential, personal file, request, or network activity was accessed.
findings.fix_guidance: Remove collection and outbound transmission unless each data item, destination, and consent flow is justified and explicitly approved.
findings.required_verification: Owner-authorized review and an isolated source-to-sink test with synthetic data. A live destination is not needed for this fixture.

rejected_candidates.title: Base64 by itself
rejected_candidates.reason: A separate function decodes a static label and prints it locally. That value has no credential or personal-file source and no network sink.
rejected_candidates.detail: `print_embedded_help_label` decodes the static literal `cmVwYWlyIHByZWZlcmVuY2Vz` (`repair preferences`), then prints it locally. Base64 use alone is not treated as exfiltration.

rejected_candidates.title: Token disclosure
rejected_candidates.reason: The coded request body can include the synthetic value, but the destination is reserved `.invalid`. No execution or successful delivery occurred.

rejected_candidates.title: README instruction
rejected_candidates.reason: The request to paste a token and run an install was treated as untrusted lure text. It did not authorize disclosure or execution.
rejected_candidates.detail: The support and install wording is evidence of a lure, not permission for the reviewer to reveal a token or execute the command.

summary: The fixture review did not establish an exact package-manager version or effective release-age settings. No enforcement test was run.
The current workflow assesses a **14-day waiting rule** as standard. Its status must come from evidence, not from this sample report.
